workflow.name: Generate an image (fal)
workflow.description: Turns a short idea into a detailed prompt and renders it with fal.ai FLUX. The PNG lands in Artifacts.

nodes.label: Write the prompt
nodes.prompt:
Write one image-generation prompt (max 80 words) for this idea. Be concrete about subject, composition, lighting, style and lens. Output only the prompt text, nothing else.

Idea: {{inputs.idea}}

nodes.label: Render with fal
nodes.prompt:
Generate an image with the fal.ai REST API and save it.

1. POST https://fal.run/fal-ai/flux/dev with header `Authorization: Key $FAL_KEY` and JSON body {"prompt": <the prompt below>, "image_size": "{{inputs.size}}", "num_images": 1}. Use curl; read the key from the FAL_KEY environment variable, never print it.
2. Download images[0].url into "$ARTIFACTS_DIR/image.png".
3. Reply with the saved path and the prompt used.

If FAL_KEY is not set, stop and say: add FAL_KEY in Hive › Keys.

Prompt:
{{prompt.output}}
